dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a moderately concave spline curvature from the posterior base through to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Small pixel radius resulting in a rounded apex classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear slope of approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.2 times the vertical pixel height from base to apex.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex arc with a consistent curvature radius across the anterior-dorsal cranial surface.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick-set rostrum extending horizontally with a tapered profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the point where the descending melon slope meets the base of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, circular light-colored patch or lesion is visible on the dorsal surface posterior to the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast caustic light patterns are refracted across the entire dorsal and lateral pixel areas.
